# Tax Treaty Rates: Get Tax Treaty Rates

Area overview and notes: [tax-treaty-rates.md](../tax-treaty-rates.md)

`GET /tax-treaty-rates` · tenant-scoped token

Get tax treaty rates for a country by country name or ISO code

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | string | Yes | Country name (for example, "Australia") or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example, "AU"). Case-insensitive. |

**Response 200**: Treaty rates successfully retrieved

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.country` | string | Yes | Full country name. |
| `data.country_code` | string | Yes | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. |
| `data.general_rates` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.general_rates.interest` | number | Yes | General withholding rate for interest income (1042-S code 01) |
| `data.general_rates.dividends` | number | Yes | General withholding rate for dividend income (1042-S code 06) |
| `data.special_rates` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.special_rates.interest` | object | Yes | Special rate for interest income (1042-S code 01) |
| `data.special_rates.interest.rate` | number | Yes | Special withholding rate percentage. |
| `data.special_rates.interest.article` | string | No | Treaty article reference. |
| `data.special_rates.dividends` | object | Yes | Special rate for dividend income (1042-S code 06) |
| `data.special_rates.dividends.rate` | number | Yes | Special withholding rate percentage. |
| `data.special_rates.dividends.article` | string | No | Treaty article reference. |
| `data.special_rates.other_income` | object | Yes | Special rate for other income (1042-S code 23) |
| `data.special_rates.other_income.rate` | number | Yes | Special withholding rate percentage. |
| `data.special_rates.other_income.article` | string | No | Treaty article reference. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found
